youtube.title: Where was table tennis invented? Not the country that wins everything 🏓
youtube.description:
China, Japan or the third one? The country that has won almost every Olympic gold in the sport did not invent it. The first games were played after dinner on a dining table, with books for a net and a lid for a bat, and the sport had a much sillier name.
Which did you pick?
